facts.fact: The Ministry of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion said its automated data analysis and cross-checking system, built into its digital platform and boosted by AI, detected anomalies in import programme files.
facts.system: AI-boosted automated data analysis and cross-checking system on the ministry's digital platform

facts.fact: The cross-checking flagged 1,013 economic operators whose import programme files held identical documents, including 278 identical CNAS declarations and 56 files sharing one tax identification number.
